item.title: Oracle books $88M Air Force Cloud One contract
item.description: This award follows a $581 million contract with Amazon Web Services as the Air Force continues to build out its multi-cloud infrastructure.

item.title: When every second counts: government tech helps first responders’ lifesaving missions
item.description: For first responders facing unpredictable moments, tech that helps them safely navigate dangerous environments is critical.

item.title: FBI gathered intelligence on reporters, religious orgs using ‘assessment’ authority, watchdog report says
item.description: The bureau also undercounts analysts’ non-compliance with assessment policies because it relies on self-reporting and infrequent audits, the sensitive GAO review adds.

item.title: VA takes initial steps to create a centralized database of veteran research info, official says
item.description: The department has created an internal working group to look at “developing a singular database where we can capture veteran enrollment data in real time,” according to Liza Catucci, VA’s acting director of health systems research.

item.title: Senators demand to know the IRS’ path forward following the end of Direct File
item.description: The IRS ended the online, direct-to-government filing program last fall and is doubling down on the free tax filing options it offers through tax prep companies in a partnership called Free File.

item.title: CISA to furlough most of its workforce under impending DHS shutdown
item.description: The shutdown would also slow ongoing revamps of a major cyber incident reporting rule that was signed into law in 2022, acting director Madhu Gottumukkala said this week.

item.title: OMB is hiring for a deputy federal chief information officer
item.description: “If you know how to run large systems, cut through noise, and turn strategy into execution across government scale, this is that job,” Federal CIO Gregory Barbaccia said about the search for his deputy.

item.title: ‘Suicide is only one option': Social Security staff newly assigned to phone duties raise concerns over training
item.description: Experts and SSA employees question wisdom of telling callers in crisis that suicide is an option.

item.title: Tech bills of the week: AI science challenge; protecting copyright content; and more
item.description: Many of this week’s proposals that deal with AI copyright material protections, tech for methane detection and environmental permitting modernization have bipartisan backing.

item.title: GSA aims to publish results on USAi program, official says
item.description: The agency’s chief AI officer discussed what GSA is learning from the new AI procurement program and how it plans to reveal those results.
